1) Computer Programs ---> Language ----> Huge Amount of Text, Books, Websites and Articles

2) it will guess next word eazily

        The sky is ___ 1) blue 2) cloudy  3) dark. 4) banana

        The bank gave me a _____ 1) loan 2) card

3) chat, answer the questions, write stories, and explain things eazily

4) Ex. ChatGPT, Claude,....

Drawbacks:

1) Hallucination — confident lies.

2) No real understanding

3) Frozen knowledge

4) Bad at exact math and logic (Ex. 38,472 × 9,318)

5) Expensive and power-hungry.

6) Can be misused

How LLMS Trained Internally

1) word ---> numbers (embedding)
        for similar words King and Queen (close numbers)
        king and pizza (far numbers)

2) Layers (Tower of Layers) (big models have 100+)
        1) Early layers: grammar basics — "this is a noun, this is a verb"
        2) Middle layers: relationships — "the word 'it' refers to 'the dog'"
        3) Deep layers: meaning — "this sentence is a sad joke about Mondays"

3) Attention
        The trophy didn't fit in the suitcase because it was too big.   

4) weights
        All this behavior is controlled by weights

5)
